trip.title: The Iberian Grand Tour
trip.subtitle: The Lisbon Loop + Oasis UK Finale
trip.route: Lisbon · Porto · Madrid · Seville · Cordoba · Granada · Madrid · London · Manchester · London

travelers.name: Jennie
travelers.note: AA 136 overnight LAX to Heathrow Jun 8, lands 11:05 AM Jun 9

trip.summary: A nonstop to Lisbon opens the Iberian leg, then an evening TAP flight up to Porto for three nights (Lisbon and Porto are one Costco package), a flight to Madrid for two nights, then trains to Seville for three nights, a night in Cordoba, two in Granada for the Alhambra, and back to Madrid for two more. A nonstop from Madrid to Heathrow on Jun 8, Avanti to Manchester for back-to-back Oasis shows at the Etihad (Fri Jun 11 and Sat Jun 12), then a 3-night London encore before flying home Jun 16.
trip.disclaimer: Fares and rates are researched estimates as of October 2026 for May-June 2027 travel and will vary with booking date and availability. US citizens need no visa for stays under 90 days; the EU's ETIAS authorization (about 7 EUR online) is expected to be required by 2027 - confirm before departure. Travel insurance with medical coverage recommended.

guides.title: Where to eat: francesinha
guides.tip: Ordering, anywhere: com ovo (fried egg on top), fries for the sauce, and a fino (a small draft beer) is the local pairing.

spots.name: Cervejaria Brasão (Aliados)
spots.query: Cervejaria Brasão Aliados Rua de Ramalho Ortigão 28 Porto
spots.note: My pick if you only have one. Modern benchmark overlooking the Aliados area: francesinha is the house star, sauce rich but balanced, premium ingredients, and half portions available. A sandwich-by-sandwich comparison picked it as the city's best overall, ahead of Santiago. Bookable, sit-down, comfortable.

spots.name: Café Santiago
spots.query: Café Santiago Rua de Passos Manuel 226 Porto
spots.note: The famous classic. Serving francesinhas for more than 50 years, and its special sauce is rated by many as one of the best in town. No-frills and busy: expect a queue, no reservations.

spots.name: Bufete Fase
spots.query: Bufete Fase Rua de Santa Catarina 1147 Porto
spots.note: The locals' no-nonsense pick. Since 1984, cooked in front of you, only the typical francesinha (no modern variations, no spicy version; add your own). Smoother, milder sauce. Arrive early; it's up Santa Catarina, north of centre.

spots.name: A Regaleira
spots.query: A Regaleira Rua do Bonjardim 87 Porto
spots.note: The original. Daniel David de Silva created the francesinha here in 1953, adapting the croque monsieur with local meats and a custom beer-and-tomato sauce. Spicier sauce with a cumin kick. Go for the history.

spots.name: O Afonso
spots.query: O Afonso Rua da Torrinha 219 Porto
spots.note: The dark horse, decorated as a shrine to Ayrton Senna. Per Taste Porto's local guide, "to many, this is the best francesinha in town"; Bourdain was pointed here.

spots.name: Brasão Coliseu
spots.query: Brasão Coliseu, Porto, Portugal
spots.note: The Brasão name again (rank 1 is Brasão Aliados): this branch is next to the Coliseu do Porto, a short walk from the centre.

guides.title: Where to eat: bars with free tapas
guides.intro: Eleven bars where a drink comes with a free tapa, in the article's order. How much you get and how good it is varies from bar to bar.

source.name: Madrid Secreto, "11 bars in Madrid where the beers come with free tapas" (April 2025)

spots.name: Bar la Amistad
spots.address: Paseo de Santa María de la Cabeza 53 (Arganzuela)
spots.query: Bar la Amistad Paseo de Santa María de la Cabeza 53 Madrid
spots.note: Neighborhood bar with a big terrace; you pick your tapas from the display case. The article puts several tapas plus a beer at about 7 euros. No QR codes or reservations.

spots.address: Calle de las Infantas 23 and 30, Calle de Hortaleza 23 (Chueca)

spots.name: El Lagar
spots.query: El Lagar Restaurante Calle de Ferraz 39 Madrid

spots.name: El Respiro
spots.query: El Respiro Calle de las Infantas 34 Madrid

spots.name: La Pomarada
spots.query: La Pomarada Calle del Conde Duque 3 Madrid
spots.note: Traditional Asturian cachopo place that kept its old look. Tapas change daily and sometimes come as pinchos. The article recommends the potato omelette and mentions a free cachopo buffet.

spots.name: Bar Sierra
spots.query: Bar Sierra Calle de Galileo 41 Madrid

spots.name: La Pequeña Graná
spots.query: La Pequeña Graná Calle de Embajadores 124 Madrid

spots.query: El Rincón Abulense Calle de Caballero de Gracia 18 Madrid

spots.name: Padrao Bar
spots.query: Padrao Bar Travesía de la Parada 4 Madrid

spots.name: Casa Iván
spots.query: Casa Iván Plaza Virgen del Romero 8 Madrid

spots.name: La Petisqueira (and La Petisqueira II)

guides.title: Viewpoints (miradouros)
guides.intro: Ten viewpoints in the article's order. Several are within a short walk of each other in Alfama and Graca, so group them by neighborhood. The article gives no street addresses; the area shown is where each one sits.

source.name: Embrace Some Place, "Best Lisbon Viewpoints (Miradouros Worth Visiting)" (updated September 2026)

spots.query: Miradouro de São Pedro de Alcântara, Lisbon

spots.name: Miradouro da Nossa Senhora do Monte
spots.query: Miradouro da Nossa Senhora do Monte, Lisbon

spots.name: Miradouro das Portas do Sol

spots.name: Terracos do Carmo

Morning departure, in Granada by late morning. Direct trains between the two cities are limited, so check the timetable when it opens and book early.
Morning departure so there is an afternoon in Madrid. Renfe releases about 2-4 months ahead; book at release for the lowest fares.

Flight not chosen yet. Madrid has many Heathrow nonstops each day, so a missed flight can be rebooked the same day, and Heathrow has the Elizabeth line into the city. Calendars load about 6 months out (around Dec 2026).

days.title: Depart LAX
days.plan: Depart LAX 4:30 PM (Terminal B) on TAP TP248; dinner and lie-flat sleep aboard.

days.title: Arrive Lisbon
days.plan: Arrive 11:30 AM. After customs your driver waits at the Starbucks door holding a Costco Travel sign (private transfer, included; the driver waits up to 90 minutes after landing). The Emerald House check-in is 3 PM, so leave your bags first. Stop at As Bifanas do Afonso (Rua da Madalena 146) for a bifana, the classic Lisbon pork sandwich, then stroll down through Baixa to the Rua Augusta Arch and Praca do Comercio. Gentle first evening: sunset at Miradouro de Santa Catarina, dinner at Bairrices, the main choice (the backup meal options are on the Lisbon Where to eat card).

days.title: Tuk tuk food tour and Belem
days.plan: Late-morning Lisbon Food and Sightseeing Tour by Tuk Tuk (about 4 hours; start time to be confirmed). Meet at Praca dos Restauradores; it ends at Praca da Figueira. Six tastings including a bifana, croquettes, pastel de nata, green wine and cherry liqueur, with rides through Baixa, Alfama and Mouraria. Afterwards, if there is energy: Belem for warm pasteis de nata at the 1837 bakery, the Jeronimos Monastery and Belem Tower, or the MAAT or the Coach Museum. Dinner at O Velho Eurico (Largo de São Cristóvão 3).

days.title: Fly to Porto
days.plan: Check out of the Emerald House by 12 PM and ask the hotel to hold your bags for a last day in Lisbon. Your private transfer picks you up at the hotel at 4:30 PM (tell the front desk). 7:30 PM TAP TP 1934 from Lisbon to Porto (55 minutes, lands 8:25 PM); a driver waits in the arrival hall for the transfer to Casa da Companhia (check-in from 3 PM). Dinner near the hotel.

days.title: Porto highlights
days.plan: 9:00 AM Clerigos Tower, entrance ticket from GetYourGuide (not booked, so check the price and cancellation terms on the listing). Then Sao Bento station's azulejo hall and Livraria Lello; lunch at Mercado do Bolhao; lunch at Mercado do Bolhao; afternoon six-bridges Douro cruise. For the sunset view, the Esplanada do Teleferico across the river in Vila Nova de Gaia (by the Gaia cable car, looking back at Porto; not checked: opening hours, or whether it takes tables), or sunset drinks at BOSCO Porto or Musa das Virtudes (sunset is about 9 PM in late May, unchecked), then dinner at Mito (book a table early). Evening alternative: an intimate fado show in a historical tavern (GetYourGuide; not booked, so check the date, time, price and location on the listing).

days.title: Private boat tour in Porto
days.plan: Open day in Porto with a private boat tour from GetYourGuide, "Private Boat Tour in Porto with Portuguese Tapas Option" (not booked; the listing returned 403, so price, start time, meeting point and whether to add the tapas option were not checked: look at the listing before booking). The rest of the day is free; the francesinha list on this page has six places to try.

days.title: Fly to Madrid
days.plan: Check out of Casa da Companhia early: your private Costco transfer picks you up three hours before the 12:25 PM Iberia flight (about 9:25 AM) once the flight is added to the Costco booking. Porto to Madrid lands at 2:45 PM (Spain is an hour ahead of Portugal). Private Costco transfer to the Melia Madrid Princesa on Calle de la Princesa (the driver waits inside the terminal with a Costco Travel sign, up to 90 minutes after landing; the transfer is scheduled once the flight is added to the Costco booking). Check-in is 3 PM. Afternoon: Retiro Park and the Crystal Palace. Dinner at La Barquette - Meat Bar (Corredera Baja de San Pablo 10).

places.name: Dinner: La Barquette - Meat Bar
places.query: La Barquette - Meat Bar, Corredera Baja de San Pablo 10, 28004 Madrid, Spain

days.title: Madrid in a Day tour
days.plan: 10:00 AM Madrid in a Day tour: Prado Museum, Royal Palace and a historic city walk. Afternoon at the Thyssen-Bornemisza, if there is energy left.

days.title: Train to Seville
days.plan: Check out of the Melia by 12 PM and take the AVE from Atocha to Sevilla Santa Justa (Comfort Elige, about 2h30). Costco requested a departure between 8 and 11 AM first, then 11 AM-1 PM, then 1-3 PM; the confirmed time comes in the rail email. If it leaves late, Almudena Cathedral next to the Royal Palace fits in first. Check-in at Hotel Colon Gran Melia is from 3 PM. Evening paseo through Santa Cruz's lanes.

days.title: Alcazar and flamenco
days.plan: Real Alcazar early with a private guide, then the Cathedral and (optional) Giralda climb, a short walk from Barrio Santa Cruz. Evening flamenco at a Triana tablao.

days.title: Open day in Seville
days.plan: Open day. Ideas: Plaza de Espana and Maria Luisa Park in the morning, lunch around the Triana market, and the Metropol Parasol (the Setas) for sunset. Pack tonight: you take a morning train to Cordoba.

days.title: Train to Cordoba
days.plan: Check out and take a morning train from Seville Santa Justa to Cordoba (45 min); leave the bags at the hotel. Mezquita-Catedral first (timed ticket), then the Alcazar de los Reyes Cristianos and the Synagogue, with lunch (salmorejo is the local dish) in the Jewish Quarter. With no train to catch, stay for the evening: the Roman Bridge and the lanes around the Mezquita once the tour buses have left.

places.name: Alcazar de los Reyes Cristianos
places.query: Alcázar de los Reyes Cristianos, Córdoba

days.title: Train to Granada
days.plan: Morning train from Cordoba to Granada (about 1h50), in by late morning; drop the bags at the hotel. Lunch at Omka Kool (Moroccan food, Calle Jardines 17, in the centre). Afternoon in the Albaicin and the centre, ending at the Mirador de San Nicolas for sunset with the Alhambra across the valley. Evening: a flamenco show in a Sacromonte cave (Cueva Los Amayas, about 1h15, with views of the Alhambra; start time to be confirmed, Viator, in cart). Tomorrow is Alhambra day, so keep it to the one show.

links.label: Viator: flamenco show at Cueva Los Amayas

days.title: Alhambra day
days.plan: Alhambra day. Timed entry to the Nasrid Palaces (the slot that sells out first), then the Alcazaba, the Generalife gardens and the Palace of Charles V; plan the rest around your entry time. Evening tapas in the centre: many Granada bars bring a free tapa with each drink.

days.title: Train to Madrid
days.plan: Morning train from Granada to Madrid Atocha (about 3h30 to 4h; check the timetable when it opens). Metro or taxi to Hotel Francisco I on Calle del Arenal. Easy afternoon: Plaza Mayor and the Mercado de San Miguel, then an early night before tomorrow's 8:30 AM tour.

days.title: Toledo and Segovia tour
days.plan: 8:30 AM Toledo and Segovia full-day tour from Madrid. Evening flamenco at Corral de la Moreria. Pack tonight for the Heathrow flight.

days.title: Fly to London
days.plan: Flight from Madrid to London Heathrow (flight to be chosen; Madrid has many Heathrow nonstops, so a missed flight can be rebooked the same day). From Heathrow, the Elizabeth line into central London, then a taxi or the Tube to the hotel by the Tower. Evening walk along the Thames near the hotel. Jennie departs LAX tonight.

days.title: Jennie arrives
days.plan: Morning: Westminster Abbey and the Churchill War Rooms, then Sky Garden (reminder: get tickets 3 weeks ahead, around May 19, 2027). Jennie lands at 11:05 AM and has a pre-booked electric car (Rent 2 Ride Ltd, 1 passenger, about 1h07 from Heathrow to the Cheval Three Quays; the pickup time is on the booking's Pick-up details tab) to join you at the hotel; celebratory West End theatre night, the three of you.

places.name: Sky Garden
places.query: Sky Garden, 20 Fenchurch Street, London EC3M 8AF

days.title: Train to Manchester
days.plan: 8:30 AM Express Tower of London tour with Crown Jewels access (about 1.5 hours guided, then free time in the White Tower and Jewel House; meet outside the Tower gift shop, a short walk from the Cheval Three Quays). Then a later Advance train from Euston, a named train chosen so there is time to collect bags (Avanti, 2h07); drop bags at the Kimpton Clocktower (check-in from 3 PM), a 10-minute walk from Piccadilly. Afternoon: Science and Industry Museum or a Man City stadium tour; dinner in Spinningfields.

days.title: OASIS - Night one
days.plan: OASIS AT THE ETIHAD, NIGHT ONE. Easy day in the Northern Quarter: record shops, cafes, Oasis's old stomping ground. Early dinner, then Metrolink to Etihad Campus.

days.title: OASIS - Night two
days.plan: OASIS AT THE ETIHAD, NIGHT TWO. Recover slowly before the Saturday show.

days.title: Back to London
days.plan: Avanti back to Euston by midday. Proper Sunday roast; lazy afternoon at the National Gallery or along the South Bank.

days.title: Changing of the Guard tour
days.plan: Morning: Westminster Abbey, Big Ben and Changing of the Guard tour (about 3 hours, start time to be confirmed; thetourguy.com, in cart). Afternoon free. Evening: Devour historic pubs food tour in the City of London (about 3.5 hours, four tastings with drinks, from about $97 per person per the tour page; not booked, so check dates and times).

places.name: Devour pubs tour meeting point (St Andrew Holborn gardens)
places.query: The Gardens of St Andrew's Church Holborn, 5 St Andrew Street, London EC4A 3AF

days.title: Borough Market and farewell dinner
days.plan: Open day in London. Borough Market for a late lunch, then farewell dinner at Gillray's overlooking the Thames.

days.title: Fly home
days.plan: Relaxed morning and an early lunch, then your pre-booked Transferz Executive car picks you up at the Cheval Three Quays at 12:00 PM (about 59 minutes to Heathrow, estimated arrival 12:59 PM, room for 3 passengers), which leaves about 3.5 hours before AA 135 at 4:25 PM. All three of you land at LAX at 7:35 PM the same evening.

transitNotes.text: A private Costco transfer to The Emerald House (Rua das Janelas Verdes 130) is included on May 22. Fallback: a taxi, about EUR 15-20.
Cercanias C1/C10 commuter train or Metro L8 (~30-40 min, EUR 3-5). The Costco package includes a private transfer from Barajas to the hotel on May 29 once the flight is added.
Not a short walk from the Calle del Arenal hotel: plan a metro or taxi ride from Atocha on Jun 6 (confirm the route and time).

Private Costco transfers are included: a driver meets you in the arrival hall on May 26 (flight lands 8:25 PM), and the May 29 pickup at Casa da Companhia is three hours before the 12:25 PM Madrid flight (about 9:25 AM) once it is added to the booking.

transitNotes.place: Sevilla Santa Justa to the hotel
transitNotes.text: You arrive by train from Madrid Atocha on May 31 and leave from the same station for Cordoba on Jun 3. A taxi to the hotel is the simple choice (about 10 minutes to the centre; confirm for the hotel you pick).

Contactless Tube and buses. For the concert: Metrolink tram from Piccadilly to Etihad Campus (~15 min) or a 25-minute walk - allow generous time back with ~60,000 fans. In Manchester, Metrolink trams and short cabs cover everything.

Jun 8 arrival from Madrid: the Elizabeth line into central London, then a taxi or the Tube to the Tower hotel. Departure day Jun 16: a pre-booked Transferz car collects you at the hotel at 12:00 PM (about 59 minutes).
Taxis run EUR 10-35 - a painless fallback with luggage.

bookingSequence.item: Heathrow transfer for Jennie, Jun 9

bookingSequence.item: Jennie's LAX to Heathrow, Jun 8
bookingSequence.note: AA 136. Add her Known Traveler number in Manage Trip.

bookingSequence.item: Guided tours (thetourguy.com cart, 5 tours)
bookingSequence.note: Free cancellation until the day before each tour. In this plan Madrid in a Day is May 30 and Toledo and Segovia Jun 7, so those two cart dates need changing, and the Girona tour comes out of the cart.

bookingSequence.item: Viator: Granada cave flamenco show, Jun 4
bookingSequence.note: About $28.45 per person (from-price, 2 adults = $56.90). Free cancellation up to 24 hours before; pick a start time when you book. The show is about 1h15, so check the evening slot fits after the Cordoba train.

bookingSequence.item: Costco Travel: Lisbon and Porto package, May 22-29
bookingSequence.note: Pay the $2,702.56 balance by Apr 7, 2027. Pick TP 1934 seats, add the Porto-Madrid flight so the May 29 transfer is scheduled (pickup about 9:25 AM), and keep the confirmation numbers in your email. Package refund if you cancel: $2,902.56 until May 17, 2027, then $370.07 on May 18-19, $322.32 on May 20, $274.56 on May 21 and nothing from May 22 (the airfare, $238.02, is never refundable).

bookingSequence.item: Costco Travel: Madrid and Seville package, May 29-Jun 3
bookingSequence.note: Pay the $2,050.36 balance by Apr 14, 2027. Add passport details for the rail tickets (needed about 60 days before travel, around Apr 1, 2027), add the Porto-Madrid flight so the May 29 arrival transfer is scheduled, and watch for the rail confirmation email (departure requested 8-11 AM, then 11 AM-1 PM, then 1-3 PM). The Jun 3 Seville hotel-to-airport transfer is not needed. Full refund until Apr 15, 2027.

bookingSequence.item: Cordoba hotel: Hotel Mezquita Center, Jun 3-4
bookingSequence.note: Booked on Hotels.com for $78.68, free cancellation until Jun 2, 2027 at 12 PM. Nothing to pay now beyond any property fees at check-in.

bookingSequence.item: UK ETA (Electronic Travel Authorisation), Kevin, Michelle and Jennie
bookingSequence.note: US passport holders need an ETA to enter the UK (the Costco emails warn airlines may refuse boarding without it). About GBP 20 each, apply on gov.uk or in the official UK ETA app, a few weeks before Jun 8.

bookingSequence.item: Madrid hotel: Hotel Francisco I, Jun 6-8
bookingSequence.note: $505 for the two nights. Book on the hotel website (Calle del Arenal 15) and check the cancellation terms there.

bookingSequence.item: Granada hotel Jun 4-6
bookingSequence.note: Not chosen yet. Granada is the one to lock early: it is busy in late spring and the hotels near the Alhambra fill first. Use flexible rates.

bookingSequence.item: Alhambra tickets, Nasrid Palaces timed entry, Sat Jun 5
bookingSequence.note: The popular slots sell out, and the Nasrid Palaces entry is the one that goes first. Check the official site for the release date (about 3 months ahead) and book the day it opens; names must match the passports.

bookingSequence.item: Other hotels (Marriott/Autograph)
bookingSequence.note: Marriott.com takes late-May 2027 bookings now - use flexible member rates and rebook if prices drop.

bookingSequence.item: Porto to Madrid flight, May 29
bookingSequence.note: Iberia nonstop, 12:25 PM to 2:45 PM, Optima fare with a checked bag included, $197.40 for two (price you checked). Book it, then add it to the Costco Lisbon and Porto booking (Porto pickup three hours before, about 9:25 AM) and to the Costco Madrid and Seville booking (Madrid arrival transfer).

bookingSequence.item: Madrid to London Heathrow flight, Jun 8
bookingSequence.note: Flight to be decided. Madrid has many Heathrow nonstops each day, so a missed flight can be rebooked the same day. Calendars load about 6 months out.

bookingSequence.item: Renfe trains: Seville-Cordoba Jun 3, Cordoba-Granada Jun 4, Granada-Madrid Jun 6
bookingSequence.note: Renfe releases about 2-4 months ahead; book at release for the lowest fares.

bookingSequence.item: Avanti London-Manchester
bookingSequence.note: Jun 10: Standard Premium Advance Single, cheapest at release (about 12 weeks ahead). Jun 13: First Class Anytime single, any train, refundable for a small fee. Trains around the show weekend fill fast.

bookingSequence.note: Timed entries and reservations.
